summary: The Node seam itself closes the causal RED: stage completes without swapHead, publish does one old-to-new CAS with reread, recovery is non-activating and pin-bound, and commit/export/product surfaces stay compatible. Closure is blocked by a false retained-evidence conjunction: the 86/86 JSON is a 7-file, 14-suite report, not the claimed eight-file selection that includes the GREEN tests.

findings.title: Retained 86/86 report does not include the claimed eighth GREEN file
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0b0a-green-c1e443fc/retained.json is numTotalTests=86, numTotalTestSuites=14, and contains phase-3h/activation/cleanup paths but not staged-handoff-red, successor-published, or true-fork. The seven historical files already contain 86 it() cases (24+9+9+13+17+3+11); focused.json shows the eighth file is 3 tests / 2 suites. green-ledger.md and the plan still call this an eight-file 86/86 with 14 suites.
findings.required_action: Either re-run the real eight-file retained selection and replace retained.json/hashes (expected 89 tests / 16 suites) or rewrite the ledger/plan to the actual seven-file 86/14 report plus the separate focused 3/3. Do not keep both 'eight files' and '86/86 / 14 suites'.

findings.title: No explicit six-step modeled pending/stable composition table
findings.evidence: tests/phase-6b-d110c-0b0a-staged-handoff-red.test.ts exercises genuine stage-then-publish, equivalent Completes, old/new recovery, commit-then-throw reread, and fail-closed rows, but never composes stage → modeled provider pending → publish → modeled stable → recovery as a tests-only decision model.
findings.required_action: Owner: D.110c-0b0 product composition. Disposition: optional tests-only table; do not treat it as a Node-seam defect. 0b0 owns the frozen six-step product/provider order.
